title: Indonesia's Anak Krakatau volcano erupts, cancelling flights at Jakarta airport and others

en: Indonesia's Anak Krakatau volcano erupts, cancelling flights at Jakarta airport and others. Anak Krakatau volcano erupted in Indonesia early Sunday, prompting the cancellation of all flights at Jakarta’s Soekarno-Hatta International Airport and disrupting other domestic airports as volcanic ash drifted across parts of western Indonesia.
